chunks: He said: Al-Sharif Abu Muhammad al-Hasan ibn Hamza al-Tabari reported to me from Abul Hasan Ali ibn Hatim al-Qazwini, who reported from Abul Abbas Muhammad ibn Ja’far al-Makhzumi, who reported from Muhammad ibn Shammun al-Basri, from Abdullah ibn Abdul Rahman, who said: al-Husayn ibn Zayd narrated to me from Ja’far ibn Muhammad, from his father, peace be upon them both.
He said: Whoever helps us with his tongue against our enemy, Allah will make him speak his argument on the Day he stands before Him, the Mighty and Majestic.

key_terms.أنطقه الله بحجته: Allah will make him speak his argument — divine assistance on Judgment Day
key_terms.بلسانه: With his tongue — verbal support and advocacy
key_terms.عز وجل: The Mighty and Majestic — reverential epithet for Allah

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for verbally defending Ahl al-Bayt according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (AS), through his son Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq (AS), teaches that those who verbally defend Ahl al-Bayt against their enemies will be divinely assisted with eloquence on the Day of Judgment. This hadith encourages believers to use their speech in defense of the Imams, promising a reward of divine advocacy in the Hereafter.
